about_the_game:
It’s Not Easy to Stay on Track
All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a 10-15 minute (give or take a few dozen hours of watching Steamboat Willie on loop) adventure game that takes place on an interdimensional train. You wake up on the train with no memories of who you are or what you are doing on this train.

Explore! 
Explore each of the nooks and crannies of this 1950s-inspired luxury train (but between dimensions). Talk to each of the passengers, and find secret activities!

Narrative! 
Enjoy All Aboard! The Twilight Trains' blend of humorous and emotional storytelling. Spend time with such characters as the wacky Conductor, the kooky Bartender, and the quirky Attendant (who are definitely not the same character in a different hat). Along the way, you will learn the emotional story of the Felinis Family as you help them find their lost son, Ruckus.

TRASHKETBALL! 
Experience the high-octane thrill of our innovative mini-game, “TRASHKETBALL!” The goal is to throw trash into a trash bin and get the high-score (disclaimer: All Aboard! The Twilight Train does not record your score for throwing trash in a trash bin)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Anything made within the last decade.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Anything made within the last decade.
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Anything.
  • VR Support: None.
  • Additional Notes: These requirements are simply meant to reflect that the game should be very easy to run on most machines.

short_description: All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a first-person narrative-adventure set on an interdimensional train. Explore the train, talk to the passengers, drink carrot juice, and help fellow passengers make it to their destination off this weird train.
